steps.text: The SpeedCtrl budget covers the largest time TMON can measure for a fault-free SpeedCtrl job and is at most 25 % above it.
The CanComm budget covers the largest time TMON can measure for a fault-free CanComm job and is at most 25 % above it.
The Monitor budget covers the largest time TMON can measure for a fault-free Monitor job and is at most 25 % above it.
The Supervisor budget covers the largest time TMON can measure for a fault-free Supervisor job and is at most 25 % above it.
The NvM budget covers the largest time TMON can measure for a fault-free NvM job and is at most 25 % above it.
Every task meets its deadline when each task may run up to its full budget.
The watchdog does not expire in fault-free operation, even on a unit whose LSI runs at the 47 kHz maximum.
If the Supervisor stops, the watchdog resets the controller within 80 ms, even on a unit whose LSI runs at the 17 kHz minimum.
